The components used in the development of the data logger consist of (1) the ESP8266 module as a data sender, (2) a 220 Volt relay as a connector between the ESP8266 and the lathe, (3) the Raspberry Pi as a local server, and (4) a Wi-Fi modem as a liaison between devices. ESP8266 will send the lathe condition data using HTTP GET method to the server and stored in SQL database using PHP code. The trial was carried out in a mechanical workshop, Universitas Negeri Malang. Tests are carried out to obtain data on the duration of time when the lathe is used until it is finished. The resulting data can be stored properly and can be exported into an excel file so that it can be processed and analyzed further. The development of a data logger using the ESP8266 has advantages, namely low manufacturing costs, can be connected via a Wi-Fi network, storage can be done centrally, can record data quickly and accurately and data in digital form so that it can be analyzed further. With these advantages, the preventive maintenance scheduling process can be carried out easily according to the workload that has been taken by the machine.

articleTitle: Visual inspection of molded plastic parts using higher-order local autocorrelation
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The research proposes an image inspection system based on Higher-order Local AutoCorrelation (HLAC) features. The goal of the study is to detect scratches and/or stains on pieces with complex structures, which are difficult to examine with conventional image inspection systems. For example, thin lines on pieces with complex background tend to be difficult to spot for conventional image inspection systems: because the target image is compared with the reference image pixel by pixel, pixels representing regular features may be considered as defective if a slight shift and/or rotation occur between the target's and the reference's positions, which can make actual imperfections difficult to identify. Our approach revealed that image inspection based on HLAC has excellent characteristics, such as shift-invariance and additivity, which enable detecting irregularities that conventional image inspection methods cannot.

articleTitle: Development of Learning Media for Android-Based During The COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Android-based learning media is expected to be the precise choice during the pandemic outbreak. Learning and teaching activity can still be conducted even if only through online learning. In accordance with the development of information technology which is growing rapidly around the world, especially among vocational students which makes the learning and teaching activity can be done anywhere and anytime. Teachers and learning media play an important role during learning and teaching activity which both cannot be separated because qualified teachers and also proper and innovative learning media are able to enhance students’ enthusiasm to learning and teaching activity. In this study, an Android-based learning media without coding was designed, the result of which was an Android application that could be installed on students’ smartphone so they could learn anywhere and anytime. This learning medium which is in the form of Android application is expected to help and encourage students to learn anywhere and anytime. From the results of the assessment that has been given by the application users, the interpretation value of 87.5% and percentage of interpretation assessment of the criteria value is in the excellent category.

articleTitle: Power Line Coupling Power Supply for Early Wildfire Detection Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In this project, a power supply was designed to detect wildfires with the use of distributed sensors across power lines. The purpose of the power supply is to provide 15W of power to a microcontroller, which controls the sensor nodes. The power supply hangs from power lines and draws energy by inductively coupling to these lines. The design starts with a current transformer that steps down the current from the power line, which is fed into a shunting mechanism as a safety precaution when the load is absent, then to the power supply itself. The power supply design uses a full wave bridge rectifier, SEPIC DC-DC converter, and filters to output the desired power while maintaining a set output voltage with as little ripple as possible. Based on the simulation results, our design had an output voltage peak to peak ripple of 36mV, was able to successfully supply a load of 15W at 5V and had less than 3% load and line regulations. However, the highest overall efficiency did not exceed 66%, and so recommendations are provided to further improve this design.

articleTitle: IoT Energy Billing System for PV Based Off-Grid Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study discusses the energy billing system for charging station based on IoT (Internet of Things) technology. This charging system uses virtual balances for transactions between the customer and the seller of the charging station. The customer charges the electric vehicle by ordering a charging station at the nearest place and then charging the electric vehicle according to the desired balance amount. The charging station is PV based off-grid system, that is connected to smartphone via google firebase cloud. The smartphone application on this study is separated into 2 (two) sections, in particular the seller application (the proprietor of the charging station) and the customer application (the electric charger). The percentage of error in energy, power, voltage and current readings of the PZEM-004t sensor shows an average error of 1.399% for the energy reading value, 1.55% for the power reading value, 0.289% for the voltage reading value and 1.273% for the reading value. current reading. While, the results of compatibility testing on android 7, 10 and android 11 show that the application can run well even though it is installed on various smartphones.

articleTitle: Efficient Gender Classifier for Arabic Speech Using CNN With Dimensional Reshaping
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Nowadays, gender detection is an open research in the field of soft biometrics. Human gender detection can be implemented depending on a voice or a speech. In this paper, an improved recognition rate of an individual gender detection is approached. The methodology starts with a proposed pre-processing technique, which is converting 1-dimensional (1D) into 3-dimensional (3D) data voice. Then the whole 3D voice samples are passed to the convolutional neural network for both training and testing (predicting) the class whether it is a male or a female. The number of the convolutional neural network (CNN) layers is 19 distributed into 4 rounds, in which each round contains sub-layers. The performance is extracted by using a database for Arabic speech that contains 6644 voice samples. The average result of the recognition rate is achieved up to 98.91%, which outperforms the state of the art using the same database.

articleTitle: An Automated Portfolio for Job Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The work portfolio is one of the track records of ability or competence achieved for the stages of production performance. The work portfolio can also be said to be a work that has been produced as a form of completion of the main competencies that are the main subject of the industry. The importance and abundance of elaboration points in a work portfolio can be helped by computer-based products to facilitate and direct someone in creating documents so as to produce a good portfolio. This product is a web-based product developed with agile methods. This product has three main features: the profile, gallery, and portfolio. The developed portfolio will automatically generate documents containing the user’s work that has been recorded in the system. Users only need to fill out the form and select a saved file to present in the portfolio.

articleTitle: Social Media Utilization for Alumni Interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Alumni as individuals who are very important to the university and have strong ties are expected to play a role in advancing the quality of education at a university. In this case, we propose to develop a social media application called I AM FT. This application aims to increase alumni interaction with an institution, especially the Faculty of Engineering, State University of Malang. In our research, we used prototyping and quantitative methods with the respondents being alumni of the Faculty of Engineering, the State University of Malang with backgrounds in various occupations. This application can help alumni in conveying information that can help develop the university in learning, infrastructure, etc.

articleTitle: Comparative study of Zeta converter and Boost converter Using PI controller
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The prime objective of this research is to compare the behavior of Zeta converter and Boost converter in order to achieve robust time response and proper voltage regulation in a closed-loop system. An adjustable voltage gain that depends on the duty ratio of the switch at high frequency is also observed in this article. A small-signal model for both converters is derived to achieve linearity of the system. The Ziegler-Nichols Frequency Domain Method (ZNFDM) is used for the tunning of Proportional-Integral (PI) controller to achieve better performance of the model. The time domain scrutiny of the model is performed in MATLAB/Simulink software, which depicts an improved transient response of the system.

articleTitle: Charging Characteristics of Solar Panels with Charging System Using Pulse Width Modulation Control
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Electrical energy is one of the energies we use for our daily needs. Currently, there are many renewable energies, including sunlight. With the presence of solar panels, we can harvest sunlight as electricity for a charging system. In the future, renewable energy sources are something urgent and also need to think about how to do fast charging. Therefore, in this study, we investigated the charging characteristics of an off-grid solar panel system at different voltages for several types of loads. In the experiment, we use 100 Wp of solar panels, 10 Ampere of solar charge controller (SCC) with pulse width modulation (PWM) system, 100 Ah 12 Volt of a valve-regulated lead-acid (VRLA) battery, and 100 Watt of a lamp as a load. By changing the settings on the solar charge controller, the voltage and current will change which will affect how fast energy is transferred from the solar panel to the load. The results show that for the solar panels with battery load, the increase in voltage will be followed by an increase in current as well as power transferred linearly. However, not for a full load, this is not due to losses in SCC but due to the limited power of the photovoltaic. These characteristics are indispensable for the development of fast charging systems.

articleTitle: GreatNusa: Fostering and Empowering the Society through Massive Open Online Course (MOOC)
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: One of the causes of the high unemployment rate is the large number of people who do not take higher education due to financial factors. The provision of online, open, and massive learning content (or called the Massive Open Online Course/MOOC) can certainly be an affordable educational solution and innovation for Indonesian in lower to middle class. The problem faced today is that there is still few Learning Management Systems (LMS) that provide MOOCs in Indonesia to improve the society skills. People with limited funds and who do not continue their education to the college level cannot access the current MOOC LMS which is quite expensive. The purpose of this research is to provide MOOC LMS to the public at an affordable price and can be accessed online. The research method used is a mixed-method, which is a combination of qualitative and quantitative methods. The qualitative method is intended to explain (descriptively) how the MOOC LMS is currently and will be developed through exploration of the literature study, while the quantitative method is intended to make general conclusions (explanatory) from the results of the trial (experimental).

articleTitle: Non-Intrusive Laboratory Attendance Confirmation via Object Detection using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The department of electrical engineering, State University of Malang has several laboratories equipped with CCTV as the monitoring tool. By adopting prototyping research method, the research is aimed to develop a device to detect the laboratory visitors’ attendance by implementing smart, nonintrusive, and automatic CCTV model. Different with RFID and biometric technology, this CCTV is designed without involving human in its operation. Identification of human presence, lecturers’ and students’, is carried out by computer vision techniques by using the YOLO library and rule-based method. With this non-intrusive detection, the machine will perform the attendance process that runs its operation continuously. This device ensures that lecturers and students are present throughout the designated laboratory schedule. Therefore, the information accumulated is valid for reporting the teaching and learning activity in the laboratory. As such information is also valuable for the quality assurance team in terms of analysis and improvements necessity for learning activities in the laboratory. The result of predictive model of human attendance in a laboratory reached the accuracy more than 95%. Meanwhile, the detection of lecturers and students has been successfully carried out based on the position of the human object on the x and y axes. Hence, this human object prediction model in laboratory X could be applied at other laboratories when these conditions are met: 1) The location of CCTV is the same as that of laboratory X’s; and 2) The room lighting setting is identical. Attendance monitoring continuously runs where information from CCTV is in form of static image for each specified period. Thus, attendance validity is the average detected presence of human objects for the duration of the activity in the laboratory.

articleTitle: Task assistance with human-augmented hand and its performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In recent years, the workforce of manufacturing lines that produce a variety of small-quantity products has been aging, and turnover rates are increasing. Manufacturing environments have been improved, but the quality and productivity of human operations are still insufficient, and there remains room for improvement. However, human-augmented technologies are expected to enhance work efficiency. In this study, a system that can analyze human sorting work using a human-augmented hand was developed. The system can measure human movements with six degrees-of-freedom using ArUco markers. Work procedures with the human-augmented hand can be visualized, and it is expected to improve work efficiency and prevent human errors.

articleTitle: Modeling and Stability Analysis of Active Balancing Battery Cell-Based Multi Forward Converter Using DCA
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: BMS is a device that not only monitors the energy in the battery pack but also ensures the safety and energy balance of each cell when in use. In this study, to ensure the energy of each cell is balanced, a Discrete Consensus Algorithm is proposed which is applied to a Pack-to-Cell-based BMS with a multi-forward converter. The proposed system can be modeled into LTI state space. Focusing on system stability, DCA is applied to systems such as the state feedback with a gain matrix. The characteristics of the system response can be known only from the eigenvalue matrix. The results show that the difference in DCA topology does not affect the stability and convergence of the system during condition $0 \lt \mu \le 1$. In addition, the selection of DCA gain can cause the system to be unable to converge and stabilize if it is not in the $0\lt \epsilon \lt 1/d_{max}$ condition. It can be said that the suitability of the DCA gain value will affect the stability and convergence of the system.

articleTitle: The Development of A PHP-Based Instrument for Knowledge Assessment of Learning Outcomes to Improve the Achievement Efficiency of Computer and Network Engineering Students in Public Vocational High Schools in Malang Regency
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research aimed to ease teachers’ performance in assessing learning outcomes (penilaian hasil belajar/PHB). This research developed a knowledge competency PHB instrument based on the PHP and MySQL website using the ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation) model. The product trial obtained 93,75% and was declared very valid and suitable for use without revision [1]. The efficiency tests received that the PHB instrument improved students’ learning achievement efficiency. Thus, it can be concluded that the development of knowledge competency assessment of learning outcomes (PHB) instruments using the PHP-based website improved students’ learning achievement efficiency.

articleTitle: The Development of A PHP-Based Instrument for Attitude Assessment of Learning Outcomes to Improve the Achievement Efficiency of Computer and Network Engineering Students in SMK Negeri 7 Malang
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: There are three areas of assessment of learning outcomes: attitude, knowledge, and skill. This research discussed the attitude assessment, particularly in the observation aspect. This study aimed to develop an assessment of learning outcomes (Penilaian Hasil Belajar/PHB) instrument using PHP (Hypertext Preprocessor) and MySQL programming languages. The development used the ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and evaluation) model. This study obtained results as follow: (a) the development process of the attitude assessment of learning outcomes (PHB) based on the Hypertext Preprocessor (PHP) at SMK Negeri 7 Malang was used the ADDIE research model; (b) The learning outcome assessment instrument (PHB) based on Hypertext Preprocessor (PHP) in SMK Negeri 7 Malang was feasible to use based on the feasibility test conducted by Media Experts and User Experts; (c) The learning outcome assessment instrument (PHB) based on Hypertext Preprocessor (PHP) which was developed at SMK Negeri 7 Malang has a high level of efficiency as concluded from the T-test pretest and posttest results.

articleTitle: Improvement of Visual Inspection Using Sequences of Monochromatic Light Sources
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research proposes a visual inspection systems using sequences of monochromatic light sources. The proposed method focuses on the examination of molded plastic parts. A sample is illuminated by a succession of 7 colored lights and for each configuration a picture is taken. Then, in order to spot potential flaws within a part, its images are analyzed using an inspection program based on statistical processing. For every part tested, the precision of the inspection was evaluated from the aggregation of results obtained with each light. Throughout the experiments, it was observed that the accuracy of the system had increased: exposing its targets to a series of monochromatic lights made it able to perceive more features than when it solely relied on a white illumination.

articleTitle: Inverse Document Frequency in K-Nearest Neighbour (K-NN) for Competition Recommendation based on Activity in Online Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)

authors.preferredName: Mohd Nihra Haruzuan Bin Mohamad Said

abstract: this research develops an application that can recommend for students to determine kinds of competition based on their activity in online learning. The application uses an algorithm of artificial intelligence that can make classification a requirement of competition and match the competition based on student’s ability. This research uses a modification algorithm that text mining with TF-IDF and K-NN. Text mining is used to classification a final project student when the student wants to join in the competitions and classification kinds of competition. The K-NN algorithm is used to find near points between a final project of students and the requirement of the competition. The result of the recommendation gives an average of accuracy that is 71, 65%

articleTitle: Development of Photogrammetry Application for 3D Surface Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Photogrammetry has long been used to collect three-dimensional (3D) information about objects or texture data. The 3D reproduction of real-life objects can be highly useful in a variety of fields, such as archeology, medicine, and geology. The advantages of photogrammetry research with lasers reduce costs, time to digitize objects, and have high accuracy and efficiency. This research aims to design an application that processes 2D image input data into 3D. The features contained in this application include data collection, calibration, image rectification, feature detection, and scanned images. The development of this application has succeeded in reconstructing 2D images into 3D images. In the test, the average visible point detection point is 185.4 and the mean re-projection error is 0.7542. The minimum calibration error must be obtained so that the surface reconstruction results are close to the actual shape. In the future, we would extend our work by manipulating robot movement with photogrammetry as input data.

articleTitle: Semi-automatic image generation for neural networks datasets
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms require to gather a substantial amount of data to train on. Scarcity of relevant data can make it difficult to prepare networks efficiently, so the creation of useful data appears as an interesting path to explore. In our case, the sparse data that had to be generated were plastic parts with defects on them. In order to create synthetic irregularities, several individual defects were randomly picked, warped and placed on the pictures of flawless plastic pieces. A brief succession of experiments was carried out to create a script that would allow the generation of such data semi-automatically. The process was “semi-automatic” as flawless pieces had to be cut from their backgrounds, and defects from their surrounding textures, manually beforehand. Thanks to the mixture of data the scripts generate, datasets composed of artificial pictures can be used to train/test algorithms on data that would have been laborious to get otherwise. Experimentations proved that these synthetic data were viable to train CNNs and that these networks could process new data effectively..

articleTitle: IoT and Fuzzy Logic Based Smart Mushroom Cultivation Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: the mushroom cultivation technology is a framework used to control and screen mushroom advancement during development. In this research, oyster mushroom was used as the object. Oyster mushroom development measure relies upon actual factors like temperature and stickiness. Oyster mushrooms can develop ideally at temperatures underneath $29^{\circ}C$ and dampness between 80-90% Relative Humidity (RH). With respect to the light required being developed ought not be in more than of 300 lux. To control the temperature and mugginess in this examination plans to deliver an apparatus that can work naturally with fluffy rationale control. With respect to the actual light, it utilizes a LDR sensor which will capacity to actuate the drove lights if the light is in more than 300 lux. The actuator utilized is a water siphon and fan while the sensor utilized is a DHT11 sensor what capacities to quantify temperature and dampness. This framework executes observing and control of temperature and mugginess for oyster mushroom hatcheries to build the level of clam mushroom harvests. Observing of temperature and dampness through nodeMCU which is associated with an online worker, the worker can be gotten to through the android application that has been made. Concerning watering, use RTC which can capacity to change the watering time

articleTitle: Effect of Combination Between Stator-Slot and Rotor-Pole Numbers on the Performance of Multi-Phase Spoke-Type PM Motors for Vehicle Traction Applications
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Tangential Flux Permanent Magnet (TFPM) or Spoke-Type Permanent Magnet (STPM) motors are a competitive topology in vehicle traction applications due to high airgap flux and torque densities. In this paper, the effect of combination between the stator-slot and rotor-pole numbers on the performance of multi-phase STPM motors for electric vehicles (EVs) is presented. Three-, five- and nine-phase STPM motors are designed with different stator-slot number and rotor-pole combinations using Finite Element Method (FEM). The proposed designs consist of 12/16 and 24/32 stator-slot number and rotor- pole combination for the three-phase STPM motors referred as (3P-12/16) and (3P-24/32) respectively, 20/32 and 40/64 stator-slot number and rotor-pole combination for the five-phase STPM motors referred as (5P-20/32) and (5P-40/64) respectively, and 18/28 and 36/56 stator-slot number and rotor-pole combination for the nine-phase STPM motors referred as (9P-18/28) and (9P-36/56) respectively. The 2D Finite Element Models of all six motors were run for ac magnetic transient solution at the speed of 3000 rpm to analyse the back EMFs, the torque characteristics, the speed range, and other performance parameters of interests. From the Finite Element Analysis (FEA) results, all six motors have shown to have a high torque per rotor volume, and they produced a high torque density. Furthermore, the effects of phase number, combination of stator slot and rotor pole numbers are well noticeable on the speed range capability, toque quality, efficiency and power factor of the STPM motors analysed in this paper. The results clearly evidenced that the highest peak torque of ± 243 Nm was achieved by the 5P-20/32 and 9P-18/28 motors, and the lowest cogging torque of ± 1.2% was realized by the 9P-36/56 motor, followed by the 9P-18/28 motor which has attained a low cogging torque of ± 1.92%. The 9P-18/28 motor had the highest efficiency of about 94.856%, and a wide speed range. The 9P18/28 motor is found to have an outstanding performance by accomplishing less torque ripple content, low cogging torque, high average torque, high torque per rotor volume, high peak power and torque, high average torque, high efficiency, and wide speed range capability.

articleTitle: Transient Analysis of Power Generation Systems using Wind Turbine-Hybrid on Bakaru System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The microgrid is an interconnection system of loads and various distributed energy sources, as a microgrid system, it can operate in parallel with a larger interconnection system or operate stand-alone so that if there is a disturbance in the main system, the microgrid can still perform its own distribution and generation functions. to supply the load. The purpose of this study was to analyze transient stability by simulating 3 cases, namely loss of state power plant (PLN) source in the form of hydropower plant (PLTA) Bakaru G2, loss of wind power, and loss of diesel power. The simulation results show that in the case of a generator disconnection, the loss of one generator will not cause the system to go out of sync. Because, if the generator is disconnected, the lost power supply can be backed up by the interconnection system. The simulation results of the three cases experienced a voltage drop but were still within the safe limits for the 150 kV system and also experienced a frequency drop but still within the safe range according to the ANSI/IEEE C37.106-1987 standard, namely 97.1%, 97.2%, and 98.8%.

articleTitle: Forecasting e-Journal Unique Visitors using Smoothed Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The number of unique visitors every day can be used as a benchmark to assess the success of an electronic journal. Unique visitors are visitors who use one IP in a certain period. With an increasing number of unique visitors every day, it can be inferred that scientific periodicals are increasingly in demand by the wider community, affecting the breadth of distribution and speeding up the journal accreditation system. Therefore, a model that can predict the number of unique visitors in electronic journals in the future can be beneficial for journal administrators. This paper evaluates Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) performance when predicting the next day’s (T+1) time series for the number of unique visitors to an e-Journal website. The unique visitor data sample used was from January 1, 2018, to December 31, 2018. The distribution of data testing and training used was 80% and 20%. The data quality has been improved by smoothing the input data using exponential, mean, and median smoothing. The evaluation results show that the architecture with the best performance is model 2, namely the model mean + LSTM architecture 1-5-1 with a learning rate of 0.2 and a MAPE value of 0.08098. Therefore, we conclude that data smoothing with mean smoothing can improve Long Short-Term Memory performance for unique website visitor forecasting.

articleTitle: Measurement Uncertainty Analysis of the Embedded System of Microcontroler for An Accurate Timer/Stopwatch
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In the digital era, time measurement is more widely used in everyday life. The need for exact time measurement for online business transactions and telecommunications to record time in running competitions requires validation and traceability measurements to SI units. A popular embedded system of microcontrollers with a timer facility from the oscillator frequency can be used as a timer/stopwatch application, primarily scientific measurements of velocity. This activity proposes a serial communication method. This study intends to analyze the estimated accuracy of time measurement on the embedded system device of the microcontroller. From the experimental results of measurement and calibration of time to almost 4 minutes on the ATmega328P microcontroller sample with a clock speed of 16 MHz, the resolution can be set around 1 ms through a 16-bit timer/counter facility. These results are traceable to SI units through Cesium atomic clocks with error and measurement uncertainties reaching 0.3 and 0.1 s, respectively. The proposed serial communication software method successfully helped to establish this research. A systematic error has occurred, possibly due to delays in data transmission. Human reaction time and communication delay in calibration activities need to be improved to increase accuracy. Therefore, the microcontroller as an embedded system deserves to be applied as a timer/stopwatch related to its application by an accuracy under 1 second, essentially related to velocity and sports competition.

articleTitle: Optimization of Vertical Wind Turbine Performance in Tunnel Area of Coal Conveyor
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: As a renewable energy, wind energy is one of the good energies to be developed using wind turbines. The wind source to drive the wind turbine can be from natural wind sources and exhaust wind from the equipment. Tanjung Enim is one of Indonesia's areas with relatively low wind energy, where the average wind speed is around 1.5 - 3 m / s. In Tanjung Enim, there is a coal mine, wherein the mining handling equipment there is equipment that generates wind, namely the tunnel area of the coal conveyor line. In this area, there is a blower that is used for air in the conveyor line. There is a wind exhaust that can be used to drive wind turbines. The wind speed in the tunnel is 8 m /s to produce optimal output in a vertical wind turbine. A combination of blades, namely Savonius and Darrieus, is used. This research, comparing the performance of blades on vertical wind turbines, namely 3 Savonius blades combined with 3 Darrieus blades and 4 Savonius blades combinations with 4 Darrieus blades placed in the tunnel area of the coal conveyor line. This study shows that the performance of the 3 blades wind turbine combination of Savonius and Darrieus is more optimal than the 4 blades combination of Savonius and Darrieus. The output voltage and current produced by a variety of 3 blades of Savonius and Darrieus is 14% and 109% higher than the combination of the 4 blades of Savonius and Darrieus.

articleTitle: Analysis of Fault Current Limiting on the Protection Coordination System at Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Electrical power distribution needs Cikupa District, especially the Permaisuri Feeder, is increasing. The greater the need for electricity to be distributed, the short circuit current will occur. To maintain the stability of the system in the distribution of power to the load, a solution is needed to overcome the magnitude of the short circuit current that occurs. The solution that can be used is the addition of a Current Limiting Reactor (CLR) in the Permaisuri Feeding System. To be able to reduce the large short circuit current, the CLR is influenced by the impedance value. The greater the fault current reduced to normal current, the greater the impedance value of the CLR. In addition, the use of CLR will also be analyzed against the existing protection coordination system in the Permaisuri Feeder. The impact of the use of CLR will be seen from the results of the scenario of 2 Buses experiencing short circuit disturbances of 3 Phase, 2 Phase, 2 Phase to Ground and 1 Phase to Ground. The 2 buses that will be analyzed are CA57 and TG214. The addition of the CLR makes the short-circuit current can be reduced to approach the normal current and also affects the performance of the safety relay on the system if described by the Time Curve Current Characteristic

articleTitle: The Development of Learning Media Based on Augmented Reality for Industrial Metrology and Quality Control Courses
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Industrial metrology and quality control courses are compulsory subjects Mechanical Engineering Department students, Faculty of Engineering, State University of Malang. The learning media used are still conventional using modules so that the attractiveness of students is less. An alternative learning media is needed to increase student attractiveness, namely augmented reality-based engineering learning media. The objectives of this research and development include developing products in the form of application-based learning media with the application of augmented reality technology for industrial metrology and control courses and knowing the level of student attractiveness regarding the application-based learning media used. The validation results obtained of material expert validation shows a percentage of 88.75%, media expert validation shows a percentage of 86.25%, and attractiveness students on small groups show a percentage of 95.69 %. It can be concluded that the learning media of augmented reality-based engineering measurement in industrial metrology and quality control courses is very feasible to be used in the learning process.

articleTitle: DC Motor Speed Modeling and Simulation Using Fuzzy Logic Control Method
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: DC motors are widely used in the industrial sector to help the production process to be more improved, faster, easier, and more efficient to increase the quality and quantity of production. So that this can be achieved, the role of technology is very important to be used in it. In the industrial world, to control DC motors, fuzzy logic control system technology can be used. In this research, a comparative case study of DC motor speed using fuzzy logic control is carried out with the membership function of the triangle model and the trapezoidal model. This paper describes DC motor speed using a fuzzy logic controller with simulation. The results showed that the trapezoidal model had the highest speed yield of 0.51 rad/s with an average difference in motor speed of 0.05 rad/s per second, while the triangular model was 0.43 rad/s with an average difference in motor speed of 0.04. rad/s per second.

articleTitle: Improvement Google Classroom Feature to Make It More Comfortable to Use with Google App Script
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The government supports the development of learning models by adjusting to the era of the industrial revolution 4.0. Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia (UPI) is one of the leading universities in Indonesia has implemented a curriculum that is adaptive to the dynamic changing times. Industrial revolution 4.0 impacted the learning patterns of teachers in managing the classroom to the introduction of learning 4.0 by the government currently at the Indonesian Education University, the distance learning process realized for approximately one year. Some of the problems encountered when online learning succeed are the various learning media those distracting students by adjusting the learning platform by the lecturer who teaches. This research is one of the implementations of the research roadmap on distance learning in the 4.0 learning era. UPI has provided a SPOT Learning Management System (LMS)where lecturers and students use it in the learning process. One of the other LMS available at UPI is Google Suits such as google calendar, classroom, meet, form, youtube, drive Documents, and spreadsheet where features in it make it easier for lecturers and students to study online. The weakness of this G-Suits is that the features it provides are separate so that when the lecturer is going to use it, they must be skilled in using it. This study aims to designing and developing a practical learning system that can support the online learning process at UPI.

articleTitle: Smart Parking: Symbol Detection Using Haar Cascade Classifier Algorithm To Monitor Empty Parking Slots
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study aims to create a smart parking system that can find empty parking slots using haar cascade classifier algorithm through an application on a smartphone. The smart parking system is a system created to find out empty parking slots through an application on smartphones. The smart parking system uses a web camera that is connected to an application on a smartphone with implement the IoT system. Using the Haar Cascade Classifier algorithm, a web camera installed in a parking lot can detect parking symbols. If the camera detects a parking symbol, the system reads that the parking slot is empty. Conversely, if there is a car that covers the symbol and the symbol is not detected by the camera, then the system reads that the slot parking is filled. Testing the accuracy value is carried out using the confusion matrix method from four trials get the highest accuracy value 96.29%, the highest accuracy value is cascades training with 108 images and use 15 stages.

articleTitle: Twin Rotor MIMO System Control using Linear Quadratic Regulator with Simechanics
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a linear quadratic regulator (LQR) for controlling a twin rotor MIMO system (TRMS) with Simechanics simulation. TRMS is a nonlinear multivariable system that can test flight control algorithms. Due to its high nonlinearity, problems arise when controlling motor speed variations in the main rotor and tail rotor. Thus, LQR control is implemented, so that the interaction between the main rotor control and the tail rotor can be designed accordingly. For additional functionality, we add Nbar gain to reduce steady-state error. The results obtained have improved the system to be more stable and increase response time compared to PID control. Lastly, a demonstration of the effectiveness of the proposed approach is provided by the Matlab environment using Simechanics.

articleTitle: Real Time Gesture Detection Using Kinect in Rehabilitation Therapy for Children with Disability
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study investigates the impact of interactive media with robot-assisted modeling in rehabilitation therapy for children with special needs, specifically cerebral palsy. Current technological advances are used not only for industrial production, research, or learning reason but also for health and therapy reasons. RAC2P, or “ROBOT ASSISTANCE CHILDREN WITH CEREBRAL PALSY,” is one of the rehabilitative media for children that uses a Kinect camera to display picture data. RAC2P is based on the type of movement system malfunction that children with CP have to achieve the best results while implementing each therapy movement.

articleTitle: Gamification-Based Learning Media in Object-Oriented Programming Subjects to Increase Learning Motivation of VHS Students
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The results of observations and interviews of learning media for Object-Oriented Programming subjects at Vocational high school (VHS) Malang City indicate a lack of innovation in the learning media used. Therefore, it is necessary to innovate learning media that can be accessed anywhere, anytime, and build engagement with students to foster student learning motivation. The concept of gamification in combining learning and games can be one of the best innovations to maximize the process. This development research uses the ADDIE (Analyze, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation) model. The results showed that the product developed according to the learning media expert was stated in a very valid category. The material expert's assessment stated that it was in a valid category. In the feasibility test, the test results on the small group test subjects stated that the development results were in a very feasible category and the large group obtained a very feasible category as well. Measurement of students' learning motivation in small groups, got the "Good" category. In the large group, the score for measuring learning motivation was obtained in the motivation category at the "Good" level.

articleTitle: Automatic Watering And Lighting For Optimizing Mung Bean Growth Via Soil Moisture IoT Control
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Mung bean plants are rich in nutrients because they are a source of vegetable protein, vitamins A, B1, C, E and other substances. Due to the very useful content of mung beans, optimizing mung beans is important. To accelerate the optimization of the growth rate of mung beans, various studies have been carried out as the way to find the most effective variables. This tool uses the mung bean growth optimization method by considering the optimal growth set point of humidity and temperature control with the help of DHT11 and YL-69 sensors as feedback, Node MCU as a controller, Firebase as a middle layer and storage medium and Android as an interface. The results of the tool succeeded in increasing the growth speed of mung beans in 7 days by 165% compared to the conventional methods. The objective of this study was to determine the most influential variable on the growth of mung bean and how much influence the variable had on the growth rate of mung bean. Ultimately, the proposed tools worked properly as the mung bean grew more effective than that in usual planting system.

articleTitle: Design an Interactive-Coding Web-Based Learning Module for Algorithm and Programming Course in Industrial Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Computer programming is one of the critical competencies that engineering students should have. Meanwhile, not all engineering students have enough prior experience and knowledge in programming, especially for students in Industrial Engineering majors. There is an opportunity to develop an interactive learning and teaching approach as the growing interactive online learning system, which could facilitate students achieving their programming competencies to solve practical problems. This paper presents the design of a web-based learning module using interactive coding to enhance students learning process. The system was developed using the SDLC method with 3-tier architecture. It is also equipped with students’ data, text and video learning materials, assessments, and an “interactive coding”. Through interactivity, “interactive coding” could facilitate students to deepen their understanding of coding practice from the online tutorials provided by the instructors. The text and video materials could add and drop as needed regarding the curriculum. The design result is promising to extend for any programming course in higher education.

articleTitle: DG Placement Based on Short Circuit Fault Current Component Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Producers of electrical energy are always required to meet the power needs of consumers. The addition of Distributed Generation (DG) is one of the most frequently used methods to maintain a balance between electrical power and load. Generally, load flow analysis is most often used to determine the placement of DG. If choose the wrong DG placement, it can increase the risk of adding a short circuit fault current level. This paper aims to determine the placement of DG using short-circuit fault current component analysis. The DG used in this paper is a Double Fed Induction generator (DFIG) wind power plant. This type of wind power plant is the most frequently used compared to other types. The short-circuit fault current component consists of alternating current (AC) transient component, direct current (DC) component, and AC component in rms. In the method, the case study uses the IEEE 14 bus standard. Short circuit fault scenarios occur in several buses which are selected based on the number of branches on these buses and the distance to other generators (power plants). As a result, buses 13 and 14 have the lowest fault current component levels than other buses, so that DG can be added to these buses.

articleTitle: Predictive Monitoring of Wirebond Ultrasonic Signal on Electrical Test Result Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This study presents the development of a cost-effective predictive monitoring system interfaced to an existing wirebonding machine to determine its corresponding electrical test result. The system was tested on one production lot with the data gathered subjected to a machine learning process to predict if the gathered signal will be rejected and will become a possible failure at later electrical testing. Three classification algorithms: Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, and Support Vector Machine were used to evaluate which prediction algorithm provides the expected electrical results. The study shows that 98% to 99 % accuracy was achieved in order to predict whether the lot will produce high production yield or not. Its embedded design approach lend itself well to real-time operation. More importantly this study would provide a way for legacy manufacturing equipment to be upgraded and thus be integrated into other system that are designed for “Industry 4. 0” implementation.

articleTitle: Developing Marketplace as a Promotion Media in the middle of Covid-19 Pandemic for Lawang and Singosari sub-district SMEs Product
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: SMEs has a significant contribution to the wheels of the country’s economy. SMEs could absorb labour and could generate foreign exchange, and move the economic system. Omah Produk UMKM is one of the SMEs in North Malang. Omah Produk UMKM is a combination of SMEs in Lawang and Singosari sub-districts. During the COVID-19 pandemic, society hampered buying and selling process due to the implementation of social distancing. The main obstacle faced by Omah Produk UMKM during the COVID-19 pandemic is the difficulty of promoting the products produced due to a lack of skills and knowledge about alternative media such a website-based marketing media. The purpose of this research is to develop a website-based Marketplace as a marketing media. To adjust the needs of Omah Produk UMKM, the method used is UCD (User-Centered Design). The marketplace website helps the Omah Produk UMKM sell their product and adds knowledge into Omah Produk UMKM members about how to use the marketplace as a marketing media and expand their customers through the internet.

articleTitle: Partner Industry Readiness to Cooperate in Supporting the Centre of Excellence Vocational High School
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Generally, the industry is considered to support innovation, economic growth, and individual capability development. The underlying problem is lack of readiness from the industry to cooperate with vocational school and cause a decline in qualified labourers. The solution is to cooperate in supporting the centre of excellence vocational school. This research used literature review data collection by sequencing thematic structures. The thematic structure grouped and discussed the sources following the theme or topic. Research’s theme or topic grouping shows the necessary topic type and strengthens acumen in research. The data analysis presented the vital steps for the industry to cooperate with the centre of excellence vocational school are 1) human resource readiness, 2) infrastructure readiness, 3) management readiness.

articleTitle: School-Level Based Classification of Indonesian Teaching Materials using KNN
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The selection of teaching materials should be adjusted to the student’s ability at each level. It is intended that learning can be done well. However, along with the increasing of existing Indonesian language literature, it is possible that there are differences in the contents that are not well targeted. The school should be more selective choosing the teaching materials that are adjusted the students' abilities at all levels. Therefore an automated system is required that can classify teaching material documents based on the school level. The data used for classification is a text story in the teaching materials. One method of document classification is K-Nearest Neighbor. The K-Nearest Neighbor method is chosen because it has high accuracy and respite on which it is independent. From the research results can be seen that the highest accuracy, precision and recall value is 92.5%, 93.2% and 92%. All three results are achieved at k=5, so in this research used k value k=5 because it is more optimal than other k values.

articleTitle: Vision-based Scene Recognition for Product Search
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper proposes a method that combines a relevance model with general object recognition. This method can detect general objects and recognize scenes. Based on scene recognition, object detection accuracy can be improved, and the product search time at a store can be reduced. To recognize a scene from the detected objects, the proposed algorithm uses a relevance model constructed by a Bayesian network. Experiments were conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. In the experiments, the stock status of the products and the categories of the corners were estimated. The results confirmed that the stock status of the products and corner categories were correctly estimated.

articleTitle: Optimize facial expression classification using geometric feature and machine learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Communication is vital for human social life through language, intonation, and facial expressions. The interpretation of facial expressions can be different depending on the person and the situation. Research on facial expressions developed by several researchers has not produced good accuracy, and although they give a good result, the system built requires enormous resources. This research is about to optimize facial expression classification using geometric features such as triangular features, Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR), Mouth Aspect ratio (MAR) and SVM and ANN classification algorithms. As a result, the average accuracy obtained by the system reaches 90.5%. The more features used, the better accuracy reached. Research is also proven to produce better accuracy than previous research in each class. Furthermore, this study's result could use in everyday products in order to reduce production costs.

articleTitle: Innovation of Mobile-based Pedicab Application to Support National Tourism
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Transportation online is now increasingly developing in people’s lives and making it easier for people to fulfill and help carry out their daily work, apart from that online transportation is very easy to access and the price is also relatively cheaper than other transportation that we usually encounter. Pedicab is one of the traditional vehicles in Indonesia. Lately, the existence of pedicabs is decreasing because they are unable to compete with engine-powered public transportation such as microbuses, conventional motorcycle taxis, online motorcycle taxis, and taxis. As a result, many pedicab drivers have started to lose their jobs, and not a few have swerved to become porters. The focus of the research is how to provide jobs for people in Indonesia. This study uses the incremental method with the stages of requirement, specification, architecture design, code, test. The trial was carried out through media testing and field tests with good results and included in the valid category with a value of 85%. The development of mobile apps is expected to be a solution for the community, especially pedicab drivers who have lost their jobs due to lack of income and the nature of this application is to create jobs.

articleTitle: A Novel Geometry-Based Indoor Positioning for Attendance System
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: There are boundary issues in predicting indoor positioning. Based on the Haversine formula, the distance is calculated using earth shape approaches that resemble a sphere, so there is a boundary difference between the haversine calculation and the tesseract-designed building. It leads to misclassification of indoor and outdoor positions in the attendance system. Thus, a novel geometry-based indoor positioning is proposed in the attendance system. In this study, the Haversine formula calculates the distance using the latitude, longitude, altitude, and earth curvature. Then a novel threshold is demonstrated using the limit theorem for indoor position filtering. In this preliminary study, we utilize the fixed longitude and latitude of the Surakarta Education and Training Center's Building Information Model (BIM) generated from the google API database to mark the position of the wall. Based on the test results on six indoor nodes and ten outdoor nodes, our proposed method outperforms the traditional geometry method with 75% accuracy, 60 % precision, 100% recall, and 66% false-positive rate.

articleTitle: Study Of Types of Road Abnormalities and Techniques Used for Their Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Road conditions unknowingly have a significant role in our life. Improper road conditions may damage vehicle parts and cause road accidents if not addressed timely. Internet of Things (IoT) connects sensors and devices to the internet. The driver can be alerted of any unknown speed breakers, humps and potholes using IoT. Integration of road abnormalities with google maps can help prevent many casualties. This paper presents an overview of recent techniques used to sense road conditions and provide a sustainable ecosystem to detect and notify any road anomaly on time. The machine learning algorithms used to identify the road conditions are classified based on their applicability. These techniques build a real-time road condition monitoring system for both road maintenance authorities and regular drivers.

articleTitle: User Interface Design for Counseling Guidance Applications of Vocational High School Through a User-Centered Design Approach
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Guidance and counseling services have an important role in moral assistance and directing students' talents and interests. The Covid-19 pandemic has hampered Counseling Guidance services because learning activities are carried out online. This study aims to conduct a UI and UX assessment of the counseling application based on the Cased Based Reasoning algorithm called B-Talk. This application was developed with a mobile platform design. Infernalities than the approach used is the User-Centered Design (UCD). The UCD approach is an approach that uses factors human, knowledge of usability techniques, and an interactive approach to developing design and systems. The UI(User Interface) and UX(User Experience) designs that have been produced will be tested with an expert assessment of Counseling Guidance which includes two aspects, namely usability testing and User Experience Question (UEQ). The media validation assessment was obtained from an average value of 89.2% of the standard feasibility without revision. In this case, it can be concluded that the B-Talk application design can be used as its function for Counseling Guidance media for adolescents.

articleTitle: Mapping the Educational Applications of Augmented Reality Research using A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The use of technology in education is increasingly popular, especially during the COVID-19 pandemic, where all sectors are affected, especially education. The limitations of learning interactions such as practicum in the Lab become one of the obstacles during the learning process. Educational Applications of Augmented Reality is a solution to this challenge. The purpose of this study is to reveal research trends over the last twenty years with bibliometric analysis to examine the results of articles related to the use of Educational Applications of Augmented Reality (AR). For bibliometric mapping analysis, 943 articles were accessed and for content analysis from the Scopus database from 2001 to 2020. This study visually maps scientific publications in indexed digital techniques with bibliometric analysis in various countries. This study collects data from the Scopus database, uses the Scopus website analysis feature, and visualizes the bibliometric network using Vosviewer. The method used consists of five stages: determining search keywords, initial search results, refinement of search results, initial compilation, and data analysis. Among the articles most published and indexed by Scopus, papers published by researchers in the United States (US) have the highest number of publications (107), followed by Spain (91) and Italy with 43 academic publications. Computers and Education is the most cited journal, with 845 citations. This data was taken in July 2021. The processed data shows the pattern and trend of increasing international publications in Educational Applications of Augmented Reality, namely the Scopus index.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of BLDC and SRM on Electric Motorcycle
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This paper analyzes the comparison of two types of motors, namely Brushless DC (BLDC) and Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) in the application of electric motorcycles. The development of electric vehicles is needed in the future, because of the pollution generated from conventional vehicles. At this time Brushless DC (BLDC) is popularly used as a motor drive of electric vehicles. However, BLDC requires permanent magnet material to generate torque, which is not cheap. Therefore, the Switched Reluctance Motor (SRM) was introduced as a new driving motor because it does not use permanent magnets. This study focuses on the comparison of the two motors in terms of torque, type flux distribution, flux density, heavy material, output power, RPM, and efficiency. Motor performance is calculated with the help of software along with a simulation model using the Finite Element Method. The simulation results show that the maximum torque that can be achieved by BLDC and SRM is 11.14 Nm and 10.1 Nm, respectively. Then, the results of the study also read that the weight of the material needed in the BLDC is 5.94 kg, lighter than the SRM which weighs 8.14 kg. Efficiency in BLDC is also known to be greater than SRM, which is 94.9% compared to 82.2%.

articleTitle: Designing a Transactional Smart Assistant in Indonesian using Rasa Framework
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The use of chatbots in the industrial world is increasing along with the increasing number of smartphone users in Indonesia. Many companies take this opportunity to develop their chatbot services with the help of Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Neural Network (NN) technologies. In this study, the creation of an Indonesian-based chatbot is more emphasized on the questions and answer domain, complaint handling, and transaction support at “pulsa” distributor company. Chatbots must have the ability to understand natural language, provide accurate predictions of subsequent actions and responses, especially for Indonesian chatbots. We compared several pipeline configurations in building the Natural Language Understanding (NLU) model, namely the default Rasa NLU with DIETClassifier, pretrained FastText with DIETClassifier and Spacy Multi Language Model using FastAi’s ULMFit for intent classification. The formation of the intent classification based on the complaint data log, customer service chat history and company FAQ resulted in 216 intents. The evaluation results on the pipeline configuration show that the intent classification and entity extraction tasks are better using the pretrained FastText model with an F1-Score intent evaluation reaching 73.4% and entity extraction 83%.

articleTitle: Live View Augmented Reality Technology Integrated IoT in Vocational Education Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: The major purpose of this research is to build a smart learning package for the vocational area that is interactive, powerful, versatile, and user pleasant by combining live view technology with Augmented Reality and the Internet of Things (IoT). The development process in this study is based on five stages of ADDIE development, one of which enables for mass production, which is the researchers’ goal for the next two years. The concept of Live view was first developed by Google in 2020 for the Google Street AI mechanism, however this technology has been designed to be compatible with AR since 2017. Since 2017, researchers have been working on AR, VR, and mixed reality technologies that can smoothly integrate. Although there is a lot of IoT and Live View technology, there is still a lot of work to be done in the field of learning so that the technology may be used widely. The result of the development of live view AR is a product that can display objects in real time or objects that can be directly viewed using an AR camera. This development product has gone through a series of tests in expert materials with an average of 87.45 percent, media experts with an average of 84.67 percent, and active users with an average of 89.99 percent. It can be determined that the product’s development is sound and that it can be used by the general public. Although there are 1 out of 5 scores in the “Effectiveness and seamless use of AR live view applications” category that are in the typical standard of assessment, this is conceivable owing to late synchronization. The IoT-based AR live view concept has been implemented well, with a TSe value of 612 with results of 85.3 percent, UI/UX Design with a TSe of 815 with results of 85.1 percent, and Visual communication with a TSe of 513 with results of 87 percent in the final stage of testing. This demonstrates that Live View Augmented Reality Technology Integrated IoT in Vocational Education Learning is accurate and ready to use.

articleTitle: Understanding Usability and User Experience Cloud-Based Learning Management System From Teacher Review
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: In responding to the Covid-19 pandemic, Indonesia has issued a policy regarding the implementation of distance learning at all levels of education. Several distance learning strategies using technology have emerged, one of them has become a trend, namely the Learning Management System (LMS). There are Some advantages offered by LMS, such as self-guided, portable, complete learning features, etc., to make a connection between teachers and students. To ensure a proper learning process, a quality LMS is needed. Usability and UX are important aspects as determinants of a quality system. The ideal LMS can provide services that are easy to learn, easy to operate and provide a satisfying user experience. This study aims to find out and understand how usability and user experience are by comparing three LMSs Cloud-based that are popularly used in Indonesia, including Google Classroom, Schoology, and Edmodo. The sampling technique used in this research is an incidental sampling from teachers who are experienced in operating them. Usability testing is known through System Usability Scale (SUS) method, while UX testing is carried out through the User Experience Questionnaire (UEQ). Based on the usability and UX, the best cloud-based LMS in order, are Google Classroom, Edmodo, and Schoology.

articleTitle: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis Methods for Siting Energy Generation from Municipal Solid Waste: A Systematic Mini Review
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Based on the Environmental Protection Agency, effective steps in municipal solid waste (MSW) management in preference order are waste source reduction, recycling and composting, incineration, and waste-to-energy action (WtE). WtE action is considered a beneficial solution as it works to reduce waste and harvest energy. An important step in establishing an energy generation from MSW is choosing a suitable location by considering various aspects and criteria. However, siting energy generation from MSW is a time-consuming and complex process in MSW management. A total of 32 criteria, generated by 5 aspects (environmental, economic, social, safety, and technical), were reviewed and described. Furthermore, the multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) was involved in making the appropriate site selection protocol. Based on the investigation, the most widely used criteria for selecting an energy generation site is the distance from major road. In contrast, the criteria of flooding area, distance from fault, social acceptability, and job creation are still not used. This gap provides instructions to scientists as an opportunity as well as a novelty for future research. In addition, the recommended MCDA methods with the best to the least good performance sequentially are analytical network process, analytical hierarchy process, Fuzzy, and weighted linear combination. Thus, this comprehensive information is crucial for policymakers so that the selection for suitable energy generation sites can run fairly, accurately, effectively, and efficiently.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Bagging and Boosting Algorithms on the Classification of the Popularity of Educational-themed Youtube Videos
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Youtube is a social media that is currently widely used by the public to access and share information in the form videos. In Indonesia, video content with the theme of entertainment on youtube is more popular than video content with an educational theme. So that not many content creators make educational videos with educational themes. The data used in this study consisted of video duration, type of content, availability of subtitles, number of views, likes, and comments. This data will be used to classify the popularity of videos on YouTube using the Bagging and Boosting algorithm. The stages used in this study consisted of collecting datasets, preprocessing, clustering, sampling, implementing Bagging and Boosting algorithms. This research resulted in a fairly good performance. The best performance is obtained from implementing the decision tree algorithm with boosting techniques on the dataset carried out by the SMOTE process with an accuracy value of 81.22%, a precision of 84.26%, a recall of 81.22%, and an F-Measure of 0.8272. This research is expected to provide information to content creators about content with educational themes that are preferred by the Indonesian people.

articleTitle: Exploring the Consumers’ Willingness to Adopt Innovative Wearables- An Example of Smart Compression Stockings
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks and information technology advancement have generated significant commercial opportunities for wearable health care devices and transformed health monitoring. Despite its relevance, limited research has been conducted to predict the factors influencing individual adoption of wearable health care devices such as smart compression stockings. This study aims to identify critical factors influencing individuals’ intention to adopt wearable health care devices: smart compression stockings. We propose this study model by adding several external variables to an extended Technology Acceptance Model (TAM). An analytical approach of Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) is considered for testing the proposed model. This study presents a model to explain the implementation and testing of wearables: smart compression stockings using nursing faculty at two Medical Centers to help providers increase the intention of actual users to continue adoption and attract the prospective users to use wearable devices. We found the perceived usefulness and compatibility of the respondents forming a partial attitude of using the smart compression stockings, and the attitude affects the user intention.

articleTitle: Tracer Study System Based on Social Networks with Discrepancy to Evaluate the Absorption of Vocational High School Graduates
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: This research aimed to evaluate the absorption of vocational high school graduates from the creative economy sector (Animation, Multimedia, Visual Communication Design, and Software Engineering) in Tulungagung. This study started from the description, the support programs for employment, the employment rate, the gap between the graduate labor absorption and the reality, and solutions to the gap above. This study was an evaluation using the discrepancy model. The data collection method in this research was an interview using open and closed questionnaires. The data analysis technique used descriptive analysis with quantitative and qualitative approaches. The results showed that the graduates’ absorption rate was relatively higher than the unemployment rate. Of the 112 respondents, 97 were employed, 3 went to college, and 12 were unemployed. The data from the second job was improved to 107 employed respondents and 5 unemployed. The data based on the school was 66.9% from SMKN 1 Boyolangu, 15.2% from SMK Nahdlatul Ulama, and 15.2% from SMK Veteran. Out of 112 respondents, 1.8% was graduated in 2017, 21.8% was graduated in 2018, 33.9% was graduated in 2019, and 42.9% was graduated in 2020. Based on skill competency, the absorption was 16.1% from Animation major, 21.4% was from Software Engineering major, 29.5% was from Visual Communication Design major, and 33% was from Multimedia major. Based on the questionnaire and interviews, the labor absorption reached 86%, while 10% remained unemployed, and 4% continued to college. However, the absorption had yet to follow their competencies, be it in the industry, business, and working world.

articleTitle: Empirical Formulas Between Outdoor Temperature And Humidity
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Outdoor temperature and humidity are vital variables for many aspects of life, such as determining the electrical and electronic component lifetime. However, an existing relationship between outdoor temperature and humidity in our ordinary mind is in exponential form. Hence, it isn’t easy to imagine their correlation straightly. This study was devoted to obtaining a more straightforward format to connect outdoor temperature and humidity. More than fifty thousand latest data were collected using automatic measurements to both variables for 12 months at our Hydrometeorological Monitoring Station. This station location is on Research Center for Physics – BRIN (Badan Riset Dan Inovasi Nasional, National Research and Innovation Agency Republic of Indonesia). Data analysis used the piecewise linear regression method, a method that is usually used for diode analysis. This method was also suitable with the collected data, and the purpose of this research was to make a simple relation between temperature and humidity. The result shows that there were 12 linear equations where their constants were a little bit different as a function of the month. Applying one of these equations to the suitable case, we can predict humidity data lost if we know the temperature and vice versa. This study should be expanded in the future for data from four-season countries due to contrasting climates between tropical countries and subtropical countries.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Time Series Method Comparison of Chen and Cheng Models to Predict Chili Prices
publicationTitle: 2021 7th International Conference on Electrical, Electronics and Information Engineering (ICEEIE)
abstract: Indonesia is one of the agricultural countries where most of its main livelihoods are in the farm sector. One of the agricultural commodities that cannot be released from people's lives is chili peppers. In general, the price of red chili varies relatively high every month of the year. The season can be attributed to the period of the rainy season that occurs in Indonesia. In addition to weather factors, the high price of red chili is also influenced by the inefficiency of the chili commodity distribution chain. Chili price prediction is needed to anticipate this. This study aims to determine the results and accuracy of chili price prediction using the Chen model and Cheng model Fuzzy Time Series method. This study uses data in the form of chili consumer prices from January 2017 to December 2019. The research data is from the Information System for Availability and Price Development of Basic Materials website (Siskaperbapo), which is managed by the Department of Industry and Trade of East Java Province.
